content_blocks.label: body_text
content_blocks.text: The old house on Maple Street stood silent, its windows like dark eyes staring into the night. In the dim light of her desk lamp, Elara traced the faded pattern on the worn carpet with her finger. Each step she took seemed to echo through the empty rooms, a reminder of the life that once filled them. The walls were lined with books, their spines cracked and leather peeling, whispering secrets of the past. It was here, in this very house, where her grandmother had lived until the day she died, surrounded by her beloved books and the silence of her own mind.
